summary: newDBMetrics now creates and registers three new metrics (triggered counter, failed counter, duration histogram) for selected-series compactions. They are only touched by the new CompactSelectedSeries path, so a short summary is enough; the only runtime effect is three extra exported series on /metrics.
headline: Add selected-series compaction metrics to TSDB metrics registration
reason: Only adds new metric definitions and registration, used by the new CompactSelectedSeries path; names are unique and no existing behavior changes.
